# offMetro

> > offMetro is a travel guide focused on weekend getaways, day trips, and urban outdoor adventures accessible from New York City.

The site covers destinations throughout New York State, Connecticut, Pennsylvania, and Rhode Island, with emphasis on accessible travel via Amtrak and Metro-North. Content includes outdoor activities in the Catskills, cultural tours, food festivals, and practical travel tips for exploring beyond the metro area.

## Key Topics

- Weekend getaways from NYC
- Day trips and travel guides
- Catskills outdoor activities
- Upstate New York destinations
- Amtrak travel
- Urban outdoor adventures
- New York City culture and food
- Williamsburg and Brooklyn
- Architecture and art tours
- Hudson Valley attractions
- Connecticut and Rhode Island escapes
- Pennsylvania destinations
- Metro-North accessible locations
- Tourist planning tips
- Food and wine festivals

## Weekend Getaways & Day Trips

- [Best Things to do in the Catskills: Summer Getaway](https://offmetro.com/ny/53632/summer-catskills): Summer Catskills guide: mountain biking, Kaaterskill Falls, Emerson Resort
- [Things to Do in Madison, CT: Weekend Getaway](https://offmetro.com/ny/39424/things-to-do-in-madison-ct): Madison, CT weekend guide: RJ Julia's, High Tide Gourmet, Sculpture Mile
- [Best Thanksgiving Getaways Near NYC](https://offmetro.com/ny/25446/thanksgiving-getaways): Thanksgiving escapes near NYC: Mohonk Mountain House, Omni Mount Washington
- [Weekend Getaway to Albany: History, Art and Local Culture](https://offmetro.com/ny/64709/the-best-things-to-do-in-albany): Albany weekend guide: State Capital, Jack's Oyster House, history museum
- [Things to do in Providence, RI: Weekend Getaway](https://offmetro.com/ny/51088/providence-rhode-island): Providence, RI guide: Arts Festival, The Dean hotel, Amtrak from NYC
- [Best Things to Do in Milford, Pennsylvania](https://offmetro.com/ny/43156/things-to-do-in-milford-pa): Milford, PA: Delaware River kayaking, Grey Towers, Hotel Fauchère
- [Tarrytown: History, Literature and Craft Beer](https://offmetro.com/ny/55368/tarrytown-history-literature-and-craft-beer): Tarrytown guide: Sleepy Hollow history, Lyndhurst, Metro-North access
- [Best Things to do in Woodstock, New York](https://offmetro.com/ny/48524/woodstock-new-york): Woodstock, NY guide: Film Festival, Overlook Mountain, Hotel Dylan

- [A Walking Tour of Poughkeepsie's Art Scene](https://offmetro.com/ny/67806/a-walking-tour-of-poughkeepsies-art-scene): Poughkeepsie art walking tour: murals, galleries, Fall Kill Creative
- [LUMA: A Projection Art Festival Lights Up Binghamton](https://offmetro.com/ny/61145/luma-a-projection-art-festival-lights-up-binghamton): LUMA projection art festival recap in Binghamton, Upstate New York
- [Dumbo Arts Festival, Le Grand Fooding, More!](https://offmetro.com/ny/15798/dumbo-arts-festival): NYC weekend events: Dumbo Arts Festival, NY Craft Beer Week, Queens Fair
